selected.title: UK Government takes on till fraud with POS software standards
selected.summary: The UK government is introducing mandatory software standards for point-of-sale systems in an effort to clamp down on till fraud.
selected.why: New government regulation introducing mandatory POS software standards to curb till fraud.

reason: POS software standards to combat till fraud assume technology can solve a behavioural problem; the position that mandates risk shifting costs to compliant businesses without addressing root causes deserves examination.
angle: Mandatory POS software standards may increase compliance costs for honest retailers without effectively deterring sophisticated fraud that can adapt to new systems.
